settings.title: They stay up
settings.text: A silicone grip band inside each strap holds onto your work pants. Kneel, stand, climb the ladder, kneel again. The pads stay where you put them.

settings.title: Cushion without the tourniquet
settings.text: Pads that only stay up because they're cranked tight leave your legs numb by lunch. Wide split straps sit above and below the joint, so they hold without squeezing.

settings.title: Your knees don't grow back
settings.text: Years on tile and subfloor add up. Gel over dense foam takes the pressure off the kneecap, so you can still kneel at the end of the week and at the end of a career.

settings.label: layers between your knee and the floor
wide straps, above & below the joint

settings.heading: Wear them on the job. If they slide, send them back.
settings.text: Put them through a real work week. If they slide down or leave your legs numb, contact us within 30 days of delivery and we'll make it right with a refund.

settings.heading: Stop pulling your knee pads up.
settings.text: Pads that stay put and don't cut off circulation.
